name: ssh-monitor-relay
description: Local relay agent for SSH Monitor. Tunnels SSH, SFTP, databases and agent web UIs from your machine to your server without opening inbound ports.
//: SECURITY NOTE — this package deliberately ships NO install lifecycle
scripts (no preinstall / install / postinstall). That is the whole point
of publishing on npm instead of telling users to pipe a download into
node: an npm package with no lifecycle scripts cannot execute anything at
install time. Nothing runs until the user explicitly types `local-relay`.
prepack runs on the PUBLISHER's machine only, never on the consumer's.
It copies ../../public/local-relay.min.js into dist/ so the published
bytes are byte-identical to the file the server serves at /local-relay.js
— one artifact, everywhere. That file is a BUILD (scripts/build-relay.mjs),
not the readable source; prepack refuses to run if it is stale.
